plan.notes: Source: official UPRRP Facultad de Estudios Generales, 'Bachillerato en Artes en Estudios Generales - Tabla de Secuencia Curricular por semestre', revisado octubre 2025. Course codes and credit values are transcribed exactly as printed; the official sequence lists ESGE courses by code only (no titles in the source), so the code is repeated as the title rather than inventing titles. Generic requirements (ESPA/HUMA/CIBI/CIFI/CISO/INGL/ARTES/LITERATURA según nivel) modeled as choice slots. 'Área de Énfasis/Concentración' slots modeled as major choice slots; 'Electiva' as free-elective choice slots. Prerequisites are not listed in the sequence; see the official catalog. Filed under catalog year 2025-2026 per the October 2025 revision date.
